Description: JLCPCB 2-layer PCB, 131.5 x 60 mm. Unit price is the given $7.90 quote for a set of 5 boards, not a per-board price.

100uF 16V radial electrolytic. Chosen because C1 sits on the +5V rail; Digilog also sells a 100uF 6.3V part at the same Rs 10 but that voltage is too tight for 5V. Listing does not state can diameter or lead pitch; confirm 6.3 mm diameter and 2.5 mm pitch before ordering. Price Rs 10.
0.1uF (104) THT ceramic capacitor. Price Rs 10. Page does not explicitly say disc body or 5 mm pitch; typical 104 ceramic radial parts use 5 mm or 2.5 mm leads so check pitch on the part you receive.

1uF (105) non-polar THT ceramic. Price Rs 5 on Alpha Electronics (Rawalpindi). Lead pitch and body size are not stated on the page; confirm 5 mm pitch. Digilog had no THT ceramic 1uF in stock (only electrolytic or SMD).

TDK FG26X7R1E106KRT06 10uF X7R 25V THT ceramic, 5 mm pitch, LCSC C531341. Qty-1 price $0.4769, in stock 2329 at fetch. Correct footprint match. Pakistan shops mostly stock 10uF electrolytics, which will not reliably fit a 5 mm disc footprint.
5 mm THT LED. Schematic does not specify color; red used here at Rs 3. Blue is the same price at https://digilog.pk/products/5mm-blue-led-light-emitting-diode-in-pakistan

GCT USB4105-GF-A USB-C receptacle, top-mount horizontal, USB 2.0 (default 0.95 mm shell stake). LCSC C3020560, qty-1 $1.0316, 5 in stock at fetch. This is the standard USB4105-xx-A family used by the KiCad 16P footprint (12 contacts plus mounting stakes). The explicit 16P 1.20 mm-stake part USB4105-GF-A-120 (C5184243) was out of stock. USB4105-GF-A-060 (C3025063, 0.60 mm stake) was in stock 46 pcs at $1.0134 if you need more stock.
2.54 mm 1x07 female pin socket. Digilog does not sell a 1x07; buy the 8-pin header at Rs 10 and snap off 1 pin.

Two 2.54 mm 1x03 female pin sockets. Digilog does not sell a 1x03; unit price is half of one 8-pin header at Rs 10, which cuts into two 1x03 sockets with 2 pins left over. Same listing as J3; buy two 8-pin headers total if you also cut J3 from one of them, or buy one 8-pin plus this one.
330R 1/4W 1% metal film axial. Rs 2 on Digilog (cheaper than their 5% Rs 10 listing, same form factor). Use the 330R variant on this page.
10K 1/4W 1% metal film axial. Rs 2. Schematic footprint was empty; same axial footprint as R1 used. Use the 10K variant on this page.

5.1K 1/4W 1% metal film axial, Huaxing MF1/4W-5.1K, LCSC C714010, D2.3xL6.5 mm. Qty-50 price $0.0101; MOQ is 50 so you pay $0.505 at checkout, not just 2 pcs. Digilog 1/4W pages have 4.7K and 5.6K but no 5.1K. These are the USB-C CC pull-downs; do not substitute 4.7K or 5.6K without checking the USB-C spec.
6x6x6 mm 4-pin DIP THT tactile momentary switch. Rs 20 each. SW2 and SW3 footprints were empty on the schematic; SW1 uses SW_PUSH_6mm so that footprint is used for all three.

Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16 bare SMD module (16 MB flash, no PSRAM), LCSC C2913199. Qty-1 $4.946, 558 in stock at fetch. AMS1117-3.3 1A LDO in SOT-223. Rs 20 at Digilog (live page price; an older search snippet of Rs 18 was stale).

assumed INMP441 I2S MEMS microphone breakout. Rs 550 (was Rs 750) at Digilog. Typical module is a 6-pin 2.54 mm header: VDD, GND, L/R, WS, SCK, SD. Does not plug directly into the board sockets: see pin-count notes.

assumed MAX98357 / MAX98357A I2S 3W Class-D amp breakout. Rs 600 at Digilog. Typical generic 7-pin module is VIN, GND, SD, GAIN, DIN, BCLK, LRC, which matches J3 if pin order is the same. Confirm pin order on the module you buy.
